When a gale of 400 fresh agents posts deposits in one epoch, the ledger walks every deposit back a few hops; if they all launched from one jetty wallet, they share a single reward cap until each earns income from unrelated payers. An honest agent selling, say, yarrow dosage lookups is funded by its own clients and never trips this, while a farm must find hundreds of independent funders, which costs real money.
